comparison.objective: Safely isolate a pneumatic manifold, disconnect an 8 mm push-to-connect line and blank the port; candidate separates finishing media from washers using a manual screen.
comparison.physical_skill: Valve, padlock and dump manipulation; collet depression with simultaneous tube withdrawal; precise plug insertion and retention verification versus screen grasping, pouring and granular-flow/bridging control.
comparison.success_condition: Latest PR spec requires locked isolation, pressure at or below 0.1 bar before release, line removed, plug seated and gripped, a 15 N retention check with at most 1 mm displacement, clearance and final hold; candidate uses recovered mass, washer retention, spill/damage exclusions and 3 s released support dwell.
comparison.reason: Both include bimanual coordination and final placement, but those generic primitives do not make pneumatic lockout/disconnection and granular screening the same tested ability. All ten supplied spec versions were available and consistently preserve the distinct core objective.
